evals.prompt: We need a 45-second launch video for our SaaS app. No one on camera. Here is a launch video I like: [link].
assertions: Routes to the launch-videos playbook, type A
Starts with a reference teardown of the linked video
Writes a beat table with word budgets that follows the reference
Stops for script approval before building
Uses real product screens and brand-kit colours, never AI-generated UI
Builds in Remotion with voice first and word-timed captions
Runs the final check including safe zones and loudness

evals.prompt: I filmed a 3-minute talking-head video. Edit it like Alex Hormozi's videos.
assertions: Routes to type C in the launch-videos and recording-edits playbook
Measures the style in numbers from two or three Hormozi clips
Does a transcript-first paper edit with silence and filler removal
Applies jump cuts, punch-ins, highlighted captions, sound effects and callouts
Proposes B-roll inserts for approval instead of inserting them silently
Notes that footage and delivery set the ceiling

evals.prompt: Make me an AI UGC ad of a woman talking about our skincare serum for Meta.
assertions: Routes to the AI ad creative playbook
Asks for or finds a proven UGC reference
Never presents the AI creator as a real customer and adds the AI label
Uses real product photos as anchors and cuts to real product footage for close-ups
Puts the dialogue accuracy line in every speaking prompt and keeps clips at 8 seconds or less
Uses a paid voice plan and licensed music for the ad

evals.prompt: Generate a 10-second clip of hands typing on a laptop in a coffee shop for our landing page.
assertions: Writes the prompt as subject, action, camera, look, light, specs
Names a camera movement or says static
Keeps the prompt between 50 and 100 words
Avoids cinematic, 8K and perfect, and asks for no on-screen text
Recommends a start frame and image-to-video
Names the model for the step

evals.prompt: I want to start a faceless Instagram account with an AI character who posts daily.
assertions: Routes to the faceless influencer playbook at the quick-social tier
Builds the character's two-image anchor once and reuses it
Explains faceless means the operator's face is absent, not that no face appears
Keeps each post to the six steps with reused anchors

evals.prompt: Copy the motion style of this brand's launch video for our product: [link].
assertions: Captures frames densely around transitions because Claude reads frames, not motion
Writes a style spec with animation timing, easing and signature moves
Turns the spec into a reusable Remotion template
Asks for product screens, vector logos and brand fonts
Checks the build side by side with the reference
Flags 3D or hand-drawn elements as hard to match and offers a workaround

evals.prompt: Should we make an animatic before generating the shots for our 30-second ad?
assertions: Explains the workflow has no animatic step
Explains the reference, word budgets and voice-first timing set the pacing
Recommends the start-frame contact sheet as the visual check before video
